newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end down but above lows after Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end down but above lows after Greenspan.

text.p: UK shares ended a choppy session down but well above the lows as investors continued, at least for the time being, to discount Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's attempts to pour cold water on a fired-up equities market.

"The market is content to call his bluff at the moment," said Andy Hartwill, UK equities strategist at SocGen. "What's the difference between 'irrational exuberance' and 'excessive optimism'? -- the answer seems to be 10 percent up on the Dow."
The FTSE 100 index closed 15.4 points lower at 4,329.3
